data.summary: Leidos Holdings (LDOS) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: In particular, several states, including Colorado and California, have passed or proposed laws and regulations that specifically address various facets and uses of AI.

There are significant risks involved in using AI and no assurance can be provided that our use of AI will enhance our products or services, produce the intended results, or keep pace with our competitors.
